stemMd: A cube's volume increases by a factor of 27. By what factor does its surface area increase?
explanationMd: A volume factor of 27 means side length triples. Surface area scales with the square of side length, so it increases by 3 squared=9.

distractorRationale.a: This is the linear scale factor.
distractorRationale.c: This has no geometric scaling basis.
distractorRationale.e: This raises the linear scale to the fourth power.
